description: Source code for the executor component of the PyTorch JIT fusion fuser, handling kernel execution, argument expansion, and fusion launching.

methods.name: getMapSize
methods.description: Calculates the common map size for tensors based on kernel spec and input arguments.

methods.name: canRunKernel
methods.description: Determines if the kernel can run with the given arguments by checking size compatibility.

methods.name: expandArgs
methods.description: Expands input tensors to a common shape for fusion, mutating the arguments.

methods.name: shouldExpandArgs
methods.description: Checks if argument expansion is needed without mutating.

methods.name: computeNumel
methods.description: Calculates total number of elements from tensor sizes.

methods.name: computeMapSize
methods.description: Computes the map size for a tensor based on chunk description.

methods.name: compressContiguous
methods.description: Compresses tensor sizes and strides for contiguous memory layout.

methods.name: launchFusion
methods.description: Executes the fused kernel on the specified device with given inputs and outputs.

methods.name: runFusion
methods.description: Main function to run fusion kernel: retrieves spec, validates inputs, expands args, compiles kernel if needed, launches kernel, and updates stack.
